-CICD Doctor is a GitHub App that explains why a GitHub Actions run failed. `SPEC.md` is the design and `DECISIONS.md` is the decision log (`D-NN`). Follow the phase order in `SPEC.md` (P0 to P6): P0 and P1a are done (the queue, the worker and the signed webhook exist), and P1b is in progress: the offline log pipeline (job selection, excerpt, redaction, signature), the rules, the eval runner, the lab sources, the LLM path (policy, prompt, validation, budget, fallbacks, the OpenAI client) and the safe renderer exist, with an injection suite. The live OpenAI parts ran for the first time on 2026-11-18 (D-88: the `-m live` smoke passed and the mini-eval chose `gpt-6-luna`; the live injection suite and the cache box of P2 are still to do), and P1c (GitHub) is done and was verified against the real GitHub on 2026-11-16 with the dev app, the lab and this repository: boxes 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 of SPEC §13 are ticked with their evidence (one check run and one sticky comment per run and workflow, 9.4 s from the end of the run to the comment, the same check and comment updated on a re-run). The job-level timeouts (D-73) are implemented (a `cancelled` run is enqueued and diagnosed only when a job's annotations report the timeout; a manual cancellation publishes nothing) and their live check ("Job timeouts (D-73)" in `lab/README.md`) passed on 2026-11-17 (ticked in SPEC §13; the `job-timeout` eval case is not captured yet). P2 (memory) is under way in small PRs: (a) is done (D-77, D-78): the `FastEmbedEmbedder` loads the model in a background thread of the worker, `embed` fails fast with `EmbedderUnavailable` until it is loaded, and the use case stores one embedding per failure in the checkpoint; (b) is done (D-79, D-80, D-81: `similar` in the stores, a hardened `cached_diagnosis`); (c) is done (D-81): the exact-signature cache is in the flow (`core/diagnosis/cache.py::reuse_cached` re-anchors the stored evidence by text, a hit reserves no budget and stores `cached_from`, the report says "cached from run #N"; box 2 of §13 P2 is covered offline only). `similar` is in the prompt (`untrusted_similar`, prompt `diag-v2`) and in the report (the check run lists up to three earlier runs, the comment one; D-82; box 3 of §13 P2 is covered offline only); the success path resolves failures in the database (`core/outcomes.py`, `core/usecases/record_run_outcome.py`, `record_outcome_handler`, the late resolution in `DiagnoseFailedRun`; D-83, D-84): a success webhook is a `record_outcome` job that resolves the failures and rewrites the sticky comment with the banner "✅ Fixed by `abc1234`" or the flaky one (`core/render.py::resolution_banner`, `core/usecases/report.py`; D-84), never the check run; boxes 5 and 6 of §13 P2 are covered offline only). The daily purge is done (D-85): `core/usecases/purge.py`, `worker/scheduler.py` (one `purge:<date>` job per day at 03:00 UTC) and migration `0005`. The eval variant `llm+hints+similar` exists (D-86: `evals/runner/history.py` builds an in-memory history per repository ordered by `captured_at`; the CLI loads the real embedder; box 8 of §13 P2 is ticked as mechanical, its real numbers wait for the OpenAI key). P2 (h), the live verification, ran on 2026-11-18 with the dev app and the lab: boxes 5 (flaky), 6 (fix), 3 (similar) and 1 (embeddings) of §13 P2 are ticked with their evidence, and the daily purge (box 7) was seen running in the real worker. The runbook is "Live verification (P2)" in `lab/README.md` (`lab/.github/workflows/pr-flaky.yml` simulates a flaky deterministically, failing in attempt 1 and passing from attempt 2). Box 2 (the cache) stays open: it needs the live run (key and model exist, D-88) and has its own section there, "Box 2 (the cache)", ready to run; the real numbers of box 8 wait for it too. Still open: box 3 (a PR from a fork: an organization for the fork is missing; the offline tests cover it meanwhile) and the live OpenAI parts that remain (the live injection suite of `tests/live/test_live_injection.py`; the smoke and the model choice are done, D-88). The runbook is "Live verification (P1c)" in `lab/README.md`, and `lab/.github/workflows/pr-py-modnf.yml` is the lab workflow that runs on pull requests. Its pieces: the GitHub HTTP client and the app authentication (D-67, D-68), the `GitHubReporter` (check run and sticky comment) and `GitHubPullRequests` (D-70, D-72, D-76), and the Postgres `FailureStore` (the analysis checkpoint of a run attempt, the publication lock) and `UsageLedger`, tested on both adapters (D-69), and the log source `GitHubLogSource` (D-71; tests on `tests/github_fake.py`), the use case `core/usecases/diagnose_failed_run.py` (D-70, D-71, D-73, D-75) ties them together and is wired to the worker by `worker/handlers.py::diagnose_run_handler` (D-74: on a permanent error or in the last attempt it publishes "Could not diagnose" and re-raises) and `app/container.py` (the worker refuses to start without `GITHUB_APP_ID` and `GITHUB_PRIVATE_KEY`; the OpenAI client exists only with both `OPENAI_API_KEY` and `OPENAI_MODEL`). Offline it is tested on in-memory fakes, end to end over `FakeGitHub` (`tests/e2e`, no Postgres) and on Postgres (`tests/integration/test_diagnose_postgres.py`, `test_diagnose_crash.py`).

 ### P2 — Memory: similarity, cache, flaky, fix commits
 Scope: FR-08b, FR-15…FR-18.
 - [x] Embeddings are 384-d, deterministic for the same input, and take < 200 ms per failure on the dev machine after the model is loaded. Evidence (2026-11-17, Windows 11, CPython 3.13.7, fastembed 0.9.1, `uv run pytest tests/adapters/test_fastembed.py -s`): 384 dimensions with unit norm; the same text gives the same vector alone and in a batch; the 36 reviewed vectors of `tests/fixtures/embeddings/lab_signatures.json` are reproduced with cosine >= 0.9999 and a maximum difference below 1e-3 (1e-6 held on the dev machine, but a GitHub runner CPU differed by 1e-4); latency after the load over 50 runs each: batch of 1, p50 5.8 ms and p95 10.8 ms; batch of 3, p50 22.3 ms and p95 27.9 ms (D-77, D-78). Live check (2026-11-18, real worker, lab runs of the P2 verification): the 9 failures stored that day (runs 44381406019 to 44387458250) all have an embedding of 384 dimensions, and the worker printed no "no embeddings" warning; the same test on the dev machine gave batch of 1, p50 5.3 ms and p95 9.6 ms; batch of 3, p50 19.3 ms and p95 26.6 ms. The worker logs no line with the time of one embedding, so the live latency is the one of the test. The 9 failures stored before P2 have no embedding, as expected (no backfill).
-- [ ] Re-triggering an identical lab failure within 7 days → source `cache`, and `llm_usage.calls` is unchanged. **Open: only the offline part is covered** (`tests/unit/test_diagnose_cache.py` on memory, `tests/e2e/test_cache_e2e.py`, and `tests/integration/test_diagnose_postgres.py` on Postgres: one model call, one reservation, `source = cache`, `cached_from` pointing at the origin row, "cached from run #N" in the check and the comment). **Why it stays open:** the live part needs a real `llm` diagnosis, so a real model (the key and the model exist since 2026-11-18, D-88; the run has not been done yet). The runbook is ready: "Box 2 (the cache)" in `lab/README.md` (two dispatches of `py-modnf`, `llm_usage.calls` unchanged, `source = cache`, `cached_from`, a budget of USD 0.10).
+- [x] Re-triggering an identical lab failure within 7 days → source `cache`, and `llm_usage.calls` is unchanged. Verified live on 2026-11-18 with `gpt-6-luna` (D-88) and `py-modnf` on the lab `main`: run 44418654562 (A) got `source = llm`, row `4f652496-1016-43a9-9844-59cd01417f09`, cost USD 0.000390, and `llm_usage.calls` of the day went 0 to 1; run 44419250142 (B, same workflow, nothing changed, about 4 minutes later) got `source = cache`, row `6e752720-20cd-4208-b13f-ef71c58631d0`, no cost, `cached_from = 4f652496-1016-43a9-9844-59cd01417f09` (the row of run A), and `llm_usage.calls` stayed at 1. The check run of B (135207691263, `completed` / `neutral`) says "cached from run #44418654562" and its evidence links point at `runs/44419250142`, the log of run B. The run used the budget of the box (`LLM_DAILY_BUDGET_USD=0.10`, `LLM_DAILY_CALLS_PER_INSTALLATION=5`). The offline part is also covered (`tests/unit/test_diagnose_cache.py`, `tests/e2e/test_cache_e2e.py`, `tests/integration/test_diagnose_postgres.py`).
 - [x] A lab failure similar but not identical to an earlier one → the report lists the earlier run (score ≥ 0.85) with its fix commit if any. Evidence (2026-11-18, dev app, real embedder, rules only, lab pull request 3): commit ec406a9 replaced `requests` by `yaml` in `cli.py`, so run 44387458250 (`pr-py-modnf`) failed with another signature (`cf61af7fcf9a`, against `02f69140451e` of the runs of `requests`) and an embedding of its own. Its check run 135096039161 (`neutral`, "dependency (high confidence)") lists three similar past failures, all at score 0.91: run 44382904052 "fixed by `ef39a8e473b4`" (its failure is `resolved_by_commit`), run 44385316654 and run 44381406249, each with its link. The same comment 6989535126 (edited at 20:06:46) shows one line: "Similar past failure:" with run 44382904052, score 0.91, "fixed by `ef39a8e473b4`". The score 0.91 is the one measured in the spike (0.905, D-80). Offline (D-82): `tests/unit/test_diagnose_similar.py`, `tests/e2e/test_similar_e2e.py`, `tests/integration/test_diagnose_postgres.py`. The runbook is "Box 3" of "Live verification (P2)" in `lab/README.md`.
 - [x] Isolation test: similarity and cache never return failures from another `repository_id`. Evidence (store level; the flow repeats it in later steps): `tests/contract/test_failure_store.py` on the memory and the Postgres adapters: the same vector in two repositories, 1 000 closer rows of another repository do not change the result, a cached diagnosis of repository 100 is not served to 200 (D-79, D-81).
 - [x] Flaky lab workflow: fail then re-run success → the failure is `resolved_flaky` and the comment shows the flaky message. Evidence (2026-11-18, dev app, lab pull request 2): run 44381406019 of `pr-flaky` failed in attempt 1 (check run 135074465255 `completed` / `neutral`, "Likely cause: unknown (low confidence)", comment 6989309268 published 5 s later) and `gh run rerun --failed` made attempt 2 pass.
